subject: Request: Lantern Labs accelerator marketplace credits
messages:
From: Samira Malik <samira@lanternlabs.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: cohort@lanternlabs.co
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lantern accelerator - request for marketplace trial credits

Hi Naomi,

Hope you’re well — Samira from Lantern Labs here. We’re running our Q3 accelerator (10 early-stage startups) and would love to include Redwood as our recommended inference provider for the cohort. The ask: $10k in marketplace credits (redeemable vouchers) so each team can trial Redwood for 60–90 days during their PoCs.

Quick details:
- Cohort size: 10 startups (see attached cohort list)
- Expected average spend per team: $600–1,200 over 8 weeks
- Timeline: programs kickoff Sep 1 — teams need credits by Sep 3

If Redwood can provide a partner-sourced voucher or marketplace promo we’ll feature Redwood in our demo day and include a short blurb in our partner newsletter (2,500 subscribers). Can we route this through your marketplace credits process?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Samira Malik
Head of Partnerships | Lantern Labs
Attachment: lantern-cohort-list.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Lantern accelerator - request for marketplace trial credits

Folks — forwarding Lantern’s request. TL;DR: $10k voucher to cover 10 startups, ask to have credits live by Sep 3. Marketing placement + demo day PR.

Questions:
- Can we approve $10k from partner promo budget or do we route to marketplace credit pool?
- Any compliance/legal gating for voucher expiries / T&Cs?
- If approved, what are redemption steps (marketplace SKU, code distribution)?

I’ve attached the cohort list they provided. Happy to take point on partner comms once we have a decision.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Enterprise Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 18:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lantern accelerator - request for marketplace trial credits

Naomi — good request. A few notes from pricing/CS perspective:
- $10k total (i.e., $1k per startup) aligns with our standard accelerator match.
- We’ll want a 90-day expiry from activation and per-account caps at $1,200 to prevent overrun.
- Targeting marketplace voucher makes sense (simpler for Lantern billing). If Partnerships approves, I’ll create the voucher SKU and provide redemption instructions.

Ask to Marissa/Vivek: can we cover from Partner Promo budget (not Dedicated credits)? If not, what’s the approval path for marketplace-funded vouchers?

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lantern accelerator - request for marketplace trial credits

Thanks for the summary. Approved with conditions:
1) Cap total at $10,000 and individual max $1,200 per account.
2) Voucher expiry: 90 days from activation.
3) Require a one-paragraph case study from at least 3 of the cohort teams within 6 months for PR.
4) Marketing placement in Lantern newsletter is required as part of approval.

Finance note: allocate from Q3 Partner Promo budget (account PR-ACCEL-2026). I’ll update the HubSpot opp with the budget line — HubSpot OPP ID OPP-7621.

Ben — please produce the voucher codes and instructions. Naomi — once you have codes I’ll approve the final partner email copy.

--Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samira Malik <samira@lanternlabs.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 11:28:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Lantern accelerator - request for marketplace trial credits

Hi Samira — good news, we can allocate $10,000 in marketplace vouchers for Lantern’s cohort under the following terms: 90-day expiry from activation, $1,200 per-account cap, and a request for 3 short case studies post-program. We also ask Lantern to include Redwood in the demo day materials/newsletter.

Next steps:
1) Ben will create voucher codes and send redemption instructions.
2) Marissa will confirm budget allocation in HubSpot (OPP-7621).
3) You’ll get a ZIP with codes + voucher-instructions.pdf by end of day tomorrow; please distribute to cohort and confirm receipt.

Redeem link for marketplace vouchers (for reference): https://marketplace.cloud/offerings/redwood/voucher/redeem/ABC123

Attachment: voucher-instructions.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

Let me know if that timeline works for you.

Thanks!
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Enterprise Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Malik <samira@lanternlabs.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2026 14:44:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Lantern accelerator - request for marketplace trial credits

Naomi — this is perfect, thank you. Timeline works and we’ll circulate the codes to cohort leads on Sep 3. We’ll aim to deliver the 3 case studies by March 2027. I’ll also confirm the newsletter/blurb copy once we receive the partner email.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get the teams trying Redwood.

Best,
Samira
Head of Partnerships, Lantern Labs
